{
  "name": "inite-brain",
  "displayName": "INITE Brain — persistent memory",
  "version": "0.3.0",
  "description": "Persistent, bitemporal memory for Claude Code: the MCP tool surface, six skills that teach the model to use it, recall injected at session start, and capture before compaction.",
  "author": {
    "name": "INITE",
    "email": "info@inite.ai",
    "url": "https://inite.ai"
  },
  "homepage": "https://brain.inite.ai/en/docs/mcp/setup",
  "repository": "https://github.com/inite-ai/inite-brain-service",
  "license": "AGPL-3.0-only",
  "privacyPolicyUrl": "https://brain.inite.ai/en/privacy",
  "documentationUrl": "https://brain.inite.ai/en/docs/mcp/setup",
  "supportUrl": "https://github.com/inite-ai/inite-brain-service/issues",
  "icon": "./.claude-plugin/icon.png",
  "keywords": [
    "memory",
    "knowledge-graph",
    "mcp",
    "recall",
    "bitemporal",
    "rag"
  ],
  "mcpServers": "./.mcp.json",
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "api_key": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Brain API key (optional, for the session hooks)",
      "description": "Only the session hooks use it: recall at session start and capture before compaction call brain's REST API with this key. The brain tools and the per-prompt recall sign in with your INITE account instead (Claude asks the first time memory is used). Issue a key at https://brain.inite.ai/en/app/keys — it starts with brain_ and is shown once.",
      "sensitive": true,
      "required": false
    },
    "base_url": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Brain base URL",
      "description": "Where the session hooks send recall and capture requests. Change only for a self-hosted deployment, and add your own server's /mcp URL as an MCP server too.",
      "default": "https://brain.inite.ai"
    },
    "user_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Personal memory scope (optional)",
      "description": "Tags what the hooks write and read with this end-user id, so a shared workspace key still keeps your memory yours — and brain files what you say in the first person under you, so \"what did I ask for\" later means you. Leave empty to use the workspace-wide scope."
    },
    "recall_on_start": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Recall at session start",
      "description": "Inject what brain already knows about this project into the first turn.",
      "default": true
    },
    "capture_sessions": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Capture sessions into memory",
      "description": "Send what you asked for (your messages, never the model's own output) to brain before compaction and at session end, so the next session starts informed.",
      "default": true
    },
    "recall_each_prompt": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Recall on every prompt",
      "description": "Look each prompt up in brain before the model reads it and attach what comes back as context (at most 2.5 s per prompt; nothing is attached when brain is slow or finds nothing). Needs a Claude Code version with mods; older versions keep the session-start recall alone.",
      "default": true
    }
  }
}
